title: Chicken Fajita Noodles
description: A Mexican-inspired dish featuring chicken, noodles, and a blend of spices. This recipe is a twist on traditional fajitas, with the addition of noodles for a satisfying and filling meal.

ingredients.name: yummy
ingredients.notes: Mexican seasoning blend, or to taste

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir in the Mexican seasoning blend and dried oregano.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Add the fluffy noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
